why: WIRED, a major reviewer, answers this exact question after testing more than 30 models and gives direct picks. WIRED's travel page and Macworld's pages only cover neighbouring questions: travel chargers, MagSafe chargers in general, Apple Watch chargers, and one brand. The rest are spec-based niche sites, ad-heavy listicles, and a store blog. A new page could get into the results but would have to compete with WIRED.
